standard-dialogue-before-the-blood-moon-.npc: Who are you? Why are you in my home?

standard-dialogue-before-the-blood-moon-.player: I'm [Vampyre name]. I was just looking around.

standard-dialogue-before-the-blood-moon-.npc: You half-breeds are becoming too arrogant for your own good. If you're not careful, someone might call for a good culling. Now get out of my house!
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!

standard-dialogue-after-the-blood-moon-r.npc: Who are you? Why are you in my home?

standard-dialogue-after-the-blood-moon-r.player: I'm [player name]. I was just looking around.

standard-dialogue-after-the-blood-moon-r.npc: You humans are becoming too arrogant for your own good. You're lucky you have our new leader to protect you, but that doesn't mean you can just go wandering around my house. Now get out!
